source.manualTitle: Whirlpool & Maytag CCU Electric/Gas Dryer Service Data Sheet

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the dryer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Electrical Shock Hazard. Disconnect power before accessing.

steps.title: Verify outlet voltage
steps.body: Electric: 240/208 VAC. Gas: 120 VAC. Time-delay fuse required on electric.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Electric: 240/208 VAC. Gas: 120 VAC. Time-delay fuse required on electric.

steps.title: Access CCU
steps.body: Remove top panel. Restore power only for live voltage steps below.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Remove top panel. Restore power only for live voltage steps below.

steps.title: 120 VAC at P8-3 (N) and P9-2 (L1)
steps.body: Use needle probes. Black to P8-3, red to P9-2 — expect 120 VAC.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Use needle probes. Black to P8-3, red to P9-2 — expect 120 VAC.

branches.label: No / failed
branches.oemOutcome: No L1 at CCU — perform TEST #2 supply connections.

steps.title: +5 VDC at P2-1 vs P2-3
steps.body: DC volts: red P2-1, black P2-3. Missing +5V with P14 unplugged → shorted thermistor (TEST #4a).
steps.sourceExcerpt: DC volts: red P2-1, black P2-3. Missing +5V with P14 unplugged → shorted thermistor (TEST #4a).

branches.label: No / failed
branches.oemOutcome: Diagnose thermistor short or harness before replacing CCU.

steps.title: +12 VDC at P5-8 vs P5-3
steps.body: DC volts: red P5-8, black P5-3. +12 VDC actuates relays.
steps.sourceExcerpt: DC volts: red P5-8, black P5-3. +12 VDC actuates relays.

steps.title: Thermistor short isolation
steps.body: Disconnect power. Unplug P14, restore power, retest +5 VDC. If +5 returns, run TEST #4a thermistors.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power. Unplug P14, restore power, retest +5 VDC. If +5 returns, run TEST #4a thermistors.

steps.title: CCU power verified
steps.oemOutcome: Line, +5 VDC, and +12 VDC present at CCU.
